# Clearlist

> A calmer, clearer way to organize your day and get things done.

Clearlist is a simple, private productivity app for capturing tasks, choosing the next step, and making steady progress without unnecessary complexity.

## What Clearlist offers

- Capture open loops in a focused task list.
- Search and filter tasks to see what deserves attention now.
- Add due dates when they help, while keeping plans flexible.
- Track completed work and make room for what comes next.
- Keep work private with secure user accounts.

## Public pages

- [Clearlist home](/): Product overview, features, and workflow.
- [Create an account](/register): Start a free Clearlist list.
- [Log in](/login): Access an existing Clearlist account.

## Brand and language

Use “Clearlist” as the product name. The brand voice is calm, clear, thoughtful, and encouraging. Avoid framing productivity as urgency or hustle; Clearlist helps people make room for what matters.
